name: Pubcast AI 3D Studio Stage v0
description: Contained Pubcast AI movie-studio stage environment: a giant black-box soundstage connected to a bounded exterior backlot/parking lot, with a raised Control Room 2 booth and stair/door transition back to the 2.5D Bellamy Pop studio/control room.

interior_soundstage.name: Interior Soundstage / Hangar
interior_soundstage.description: Large rectangular black-box movie soundstage with concrete floor, dark acoustic walls, ceiling grid, work lights, yellow safety lanes, clear center filming/build area, and large hangar opening to the exterior backlot.

exterior_backlot.name: Exterior Backlot / Parking Lot
exterior_backlot.description: Bounded exterior parking/backlot plane connected to the soundstage hangar opening. No city or open-world neighborhood is modeled beyond the fence.

control_room_2.name: Control Room 2 Raised Booth
control_room_2.description: Physical raised booth inside the 3D soundstage. It is an in-world access point to shared Pubcast controls, not a duplicate control system.

exit_to_2_5d_bellamy_pop.name: Door to 2.5D Bellamy Pop Studio / Control Room
exit_to_2_5d_bellamy_pop.description: Door/portal marker at the top of the Control Room 2 stairs. This represents transition back to the existing 2.5D Bellamy Pop studio/control room. No 2.5D art or zone placement is included here.

future_water_tank_zone.description: Reserved future water tank or ocean illusion zone.

transition_control_room_2_to_bellamy_pop.description: Door at the top of the Control Room 2 stairs leading back to the existing 2.5D Bellamy Pop studio/control room.

transition_soundstage_to_backlot.description: Interior side of the large hangar opening.

transition_backlot_to_soundstage.description: Exterior side of the large hangar opening leading back into the soundstage.

coordinate_system_notes: Three.js-compatible right-handed stage coordinates: X left/right, Y up, Z depth. Metadata position arrays are [x, z, y] for renderer conversion notes in the preview builder; scene JSON primitives store explicit Three.js positions as [x, y, z].
scale_notes: Approximate working scale: 1 unit = 1 meter. Interior soundstage is roughly 60m wide, 44m deep, and 18m high. Exterior backlot extends about 50m beyond the hangar opening. Control Room 2 is raised roughly 4.5m above the soundstage floor.
integration_notes: Control Room 2 is physical access only; it does not duplicate camera, recorder, lighting, console, audio, or session state.
The Bellamy Pop 2.5D transition is a marker only and should be wired into existing Pubcast routing later.
The hangar/backlot transitions are markers only and should be wired into Pubcast navigation later.
The existing /static/stage.html preview now builds this environment directly with Three.js while preserving chat, camera switching, and canvas recording patterns from the previous stage page.
known_blockers: No final manual console hotspots are placed in this task.
No final 2.5D Bellamy Pop artwork or zones are changed in this task.
Cameras/recording/audio are preview/browser-level only until Pubcast core systems consume the metadata.
